total_supply_after_constructor.meaning: totalSupply value pre-set by the HypoVault constructor
total_supply_after_constructor.checkpoint: after constructor, before first deposit fulfillment

vault_underlying_assets_after_constructo.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault after construction
vault_underlying_assets_after_constructo.checkpoint: after constructor, before first deposit fulfillment

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) observed before the first fulfilment

first_deposit_shares_received.meaning: sharesReceived minted to the depositor for the very first deposit

first_deposit_assets_to_fulfill.meaning: assetsToFulfill supplied for the very first deposit

subsequent_deposits_drainable.meaning: all subsequent deposits can be drained (potential outcome)

assumptions: The first deposit fulfillment is the checked action; its depositor and permission status are not specified by the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the exact share-mint formula operands beyond the 1-wei totalAssets denominator and the 1 000-asset / 1 000 000 000-share example, so the first-deposit mint relation is bound as the cross-multiplied sharesReceived * totalAssets == assetsToFulfill * totalSupply per the intent.
Report does not specify the checkpoint at which totalAssets == 1 is observed relative to the constructor versus the first fulfillment.

limitations: The impact is potential and scope-qualified ('all subsequent deposits'); it is encoded as a grounded Boolean outcome rather than an unconditional drain amount.
The intent's applicability condition (very first deposit) is not separately observable in the report beyond the frozen P facts, so the relation is stated without an added guard.
The share/asset proportionality is expressed cross-multiplied (shares * totalAssets == assets * totalSupply) to keep both sides in shares*underlying-asset-wei product units.
